Scene 1 turning point: The mark on Rhea's wrist pulses in perfect time with Lucian's, making his warning impossible to dismiss.
Scene 2 turning point: Lucian remains defenseless rather than forcing Rhea closer, so she chooses to return and the marks visibly recede.
Scene 3 turning point: Rhea sheathes her weapon and takes Lucian's hand; the stabilizing marks confirm that neither enemy can survive alone.
